name: idc-acrin-nsclc-fdg-pet
description: Thirty-seven institutions accrued 250 patients to the study ACRIN 6668. Eligible patients were >18 years with AJCC-criteria clinical stage IIB/III non-small cell lung carcinoma who were being planned for definitive concurrent chemoradiotherapy (inoperable disease). 173 had evaluable post-treatment PET, representing the analysis cohort for the primary end point. Please see the ACRIN-NSCLC-FDG-PET wiki page to learn more about the images and to obtain any supporting metadata for this collection.

recordSet.name: Clinical variables with measured completeness
recordSet.description: Completeness is measured from the source repository's own records. A field populated entirely with non-answers is reported as populated but not informative, because it blocks an analysis just as surely as an absent field.
